description: Sends the pending notification digests for every Observation on the Project that has not yet been notified, and stamps each one's `date_notified`. Users without permission to email all Observations only send their own. Use `GET /rest/v1.0/observations/items/stats` to check how many are pending first.

id.description: Unique identifier for this Observation Item. Pass as the `{id}` path parameter to `GET /rest/v1.0/observations/items/{id}`, or as `filters[id]` to narrow a list request.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the Observation was created.

closed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the Observation last moved to `closed`. Null if the Observation has never been closed.

deleted_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the Observation was sent to the recycle bin. Null for active Observations.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last change to the Observation. Use with `filters[updated_at]` to poll for incremental changes.

number.description: Human-facing identifier of the Observation within its Project. Sortable via `sort=number`, which is also the default sort.

name.description: Short title of the Observation, shown as the row label in the Observations list.

description.description: Plain-text rendering of the Observation description, with HTML markup stripped. Use `description_rich_text` to render formatted content.

description_rich_text.description: Sanitized HTML version of the Observation description, safe to render in a rich-text viewer.

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the Observation. `draft` is only produced for Observations governed by a workflow that has not yet been started. Filter collections with `filters[status]`.

priority.description: Urgency assigned to the Observation. Filter collections with `filters[priority]` and sort with `sort=priority`.

date_notified.description: Date the current assignee was last notified by email. Null while the Observation is unsent — those are the Observations returned by `POST /rest/v1.0/observations/items/send_unsent`.

due_date.description: Date the assignee is expected to resolve the Observation. Defaults from the Project's Observations configuration `days_due_default`.

personal.description: Whether the Observation is private. Private Observations are visible only to their creator, assignees, distribution members, and Observations admins.

origin.description: The record this Observation was created from. Null when the Observation was created directly in the Observations tool. `payload` keys vary by `type`.

type.description: Kind of record the Observation originated from.

payload.description: Identifiers for the originating record. Only the keys relevant to `type` are present.

assignee.description: Most recently added assignee. Null when the Observation has no assignees. Read the full list from `assignees`.

id.description: User ID of the assignee. Matches an `id` from `GET /rest/v1.0/observations/assignees`.

vendor.description: Company the assignee belongs to. Null when the assignee is not associated with a vendor.

assignees.description: Every user currently assigned to the Observation, most recently added first. Empty when the Observation is unassigned. Set with `observation[assignee_ids]`.

created_by.description: User recorded as the author of the Observation.

login.description: Email address the creator signs in with.

company_name.description: Name of the vendor the creator belongs to in this Procore company directory. Null when the creator is not associated with a vendor.

location.description: Location the Observation was recorded at. Null when no location is set. Filter collections with `filters[location_id]`.

id.description: ID of the Location. Pass as `observation[location_id]` on create or update.

name.description: Full multi-tier path of the Location, tiers joined with `>`.

node_name.description: Name of the deepest Location tier only, without its ancestors.

parent_id.description: ID of the parent Location tier. Null for a top-level Location. Use to walk the Location hierarchy.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the Location was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last change to the Location.

specification_section.description: Specification Section the Observation references. Null when no section is set.

number.description: Section number as printed in the specification book.

latest_revision_url.description: Time-limited URL to the PDF of the section's current revision. Null when the section has no uploaded revision.

current_revision_id.description: ID of the section's current revision. Null when the section has no revisions.

viewable_document_id.description: ID of the viewable document generated for the current revision, for use with the document viewer. Null while conversion is pending.

trade.description: Trade responsible for the Observation. Null when no trade is set. Filter collections with `filters[trade_ids]`.

id.description: ID of the Trade. Pass as `observation[trade_id]` on create or update.

active.description: Whether the Trade can still be selected on new records. Inactive Trades remain on existing Observations.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last change to the Trade.

category.description: Observations Category of this Observation's type, flattened for convenience. Null when the Observation has no type. Use `grouping` to route the item to the Quality or Safety area when the Company h...

name.description: Stable, unlocalized name of the Observations Category.

grouping.description: Top-level bucket the Observations Category rolls up to.

id.description: ID of the Observation Type. Pass as `observation[type_id]` on create or update, or as `filters[type_id]` when listing.

category.description: Localized display name of the type's Observations Category. Companies can define their own categories, so treat this as free-form text; use `category_key` for programmatic comparisons.

category_key.description: Stable, unlocalized key of the type's Observations Category. Prefer this over `category` when branching on category in code.

category_id.description: Deprecated — not returned by this endpoint. Use `type.observations_category.id`.

name.description: Display name of the Observation Type, localized where a translation exists.

observations_category.description: The Observations Category the type belongs to. Managed via `GET /rest/v2.0/companies/{company_id}/observations/categories`.

active.description: Whether the type can be selected on new Observations in this Project. Inactive types are still returned so existing Observations render correctly.

company_active.description: Whether the type is active at the Company level, ignoring any project-level override. Compare with `active` to detect a type enabled company-wide but switched off for this Project.

parent_inactive.description: True when this is a project-level type whose parent company-level type has been deactivated.

in_use.description: Whether at least one Observation references this type. Always true here, since the Observation being serialized uses it.

kind.description: Whether the type is owned by the Company or defined on a single Project.

name_translations.description: Company-authored translations of the type name, keyed by locale code. Null when the Company has not configured custom translations for this type. Additional locale keys beyond those listed may be p...

localized_name.description: Type name resolved for the locale of the request, falling back to the Company default and then the stored name.

custom_fields.description: Values for the Custom Fields configured on the Observations Category Configurable Field Set that applies to this Observation. Keys are `custom_field_{custom_field_definition_id}`; the definitions a...

custom_field_%{custom_field_string_defin.description: A Custom Field whose definition has a `string` data type.

custom_field_%{custom_field_decimal_defi.description: A Custom Field whose definition has a `decimal` data type.

custom_field_%{custom_field_boolean_defi.description: A Custom Field whose definition has a `boolean` data type.

custom_field_%{custom_field_lov_entry_de.description: A Custom Field whose definition has a `lov_entry` data type — a single selection from a configured list of values.

custom_field_%{custom_field_lov_entries_.description: A Custom Field whose definition has a `lov_entries` data type — multiple selections from a configured list of values.

permissions.description: What the requesting user may do with this Observation. Only populated when the request asks for a permission-aware view (`view=permissions` or `view=web`); null otherwise.

can_edit.description: Whether the requesting user can update this Observation. When false, a `PATCH` to the Observation will be rejected.
